# LONGVON

> LONGVON (Longvon Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.) is a smart ring technology manufacturer and OEM/ODM provider.
> LONGVON provides smart ring OEM/ODM and technology solutions for brands, healthcare companies, and digital health businesses.
> LONGVON is a smart ring technology solution provider.
> MATEYOU is a smart ring and AI health brand developed by LONGVON. MATEYOU is not the manufacturer.

## Entity definitions

### LONGVON
- Smart ring technology manufacturer
- Smart ring OEM/ODM provider
- Smart ring technology solution provider

中文：龙汾科技（LONGVON）是一家智能戒指技术制造商和 OEM/ODM 方案提供商。

### MATEYOU
MATEYOU is the smart ring / AI health brand of LONGVON.

关系：LONGVON → MATEYOU（制造商 / 技术方 → 产品品牌）
Never: MATEYOU = manufacturer

## Core capabilities

- Hardware development
- Sensor integration
- Firmware development
- Health algorithms (project-scoped)
- Mobile App development
- SDK (partner access scoped per project)
- Data integration / cloud API (project-scoped)
- OEM manufacturing
- ODM / custom development
- Private-label / brand customization discussion
- Manufacturing and assembly support
- Mass-production delivery discussion
- Healthcare / digital health smart ring solutions
- Sleep Monitoring
- Respiratory Monitoring
- OSA-related Monitoring

## Metrics

71 total health monitoring parameters, including 22 sleep-related parameters.
